title: Determine how location impacts interest rates (Gi* hot spots + GWR)
required_outputs: interest_rates.png (optional; results are checked from the captured or saved per-tract data)
method: Select ZIP3 tracts with AcceptedLo >= 30 (808); Gi* on AveInteres with the ArcGIS default fixed distance band (202.6 km, binary incl. self, row-standardised), analytical z, FDR bins; GWR AveInteres ~ AveLoanGra with an adaptive bisquare kernel of 22 nearest neighbours (mgwr) on centroids in USA Contiguous Albers.
benchmark_defects: The task title/instruction says 'Generalized Weighted Regression'; the method is Geographically Weighted Regression.

Domain knowledge says 'load tracts' / 'load data' for 'loan'; the explanatory variable (AveLoanGra) is not named in the instruction, only in the benchmark's code; any 22-NN GWR of AveInteres is accepted.
AveInteres and AveLoanGra correlate at r = 0.97 (LendingClub sets rates by grade), so the GWR mostly shows where the grade-to-rate mapping differs; global R2 0.98.
checks: required: a table of exactly the 808 tracts with AcceptedLo >= 30

required: a z-like per-tract column with Pearson >= 0.85 to a checker-computed Gi* of AveInteres (distance band / ISA peak band / KNN8 / Queen; self 0/1; binary/row), and not closer to a Gi* of AveLoanGra
required: a per-tract local slope with Pearson >= 0.95 to the gold 22-NN bisquare GWR or to any 22-NN GWR of AveInteres (checker fits several covariate sets, Gaussian/bisquare)
